resources.string: Smoother motion through a mod the PC puts in the game’s folder
Smoother motion in games that offer DLSS frame generation, through a mod the PC puts in the game’s folder. Leave it off for online games: one may treat a mod as cheating.
The PC offers no frame generation for this game.
Turning it on removes the earlier neural upscaling from the game’s folder first.
The PC can’t change it right now.

Frame generation puts a third-party mod into the game’s folder, where the game loads it in place of its own DLSS frame generation. The PC downloads it from its authors’ GitHub release; it is not made or endorsed by AMD or NVIDIA.\n\nThe PC refuses games with a known anti-cheat in their install and games Steam lists Valve Anti-Cheat for, but an online game may still treat a mod as cheating. Use it at your own risk.
